findings: Native SIMPLE uses an under-relaxed implicit momentum matrix and rAU-based pressure Laplacian; old WebGPU is explicit projection
Native case dictionary constructor chooses BINOMIAL omega blending; prior stepwise-default claim was incorrect
SST effective diffusivity is interpolated at faces; old WebGPU multiplies its eddy diffusion by cell-local alpha
GbyNu uses the deviatoric symmetric stress contraction, not S2 alone
Native convection is bounded linearUpwindV with cell-limited Gauss gradients, old WebGPU uses distance-free van Leer
Native conforming polyhedral mesh and limited non-orthogonal correction are not reproduced by a Cartesian staggered matrix
SIMPLE consistent yes uses rAtU = 1/(1/rAU-H1), with previous-pressure corrections in HbyA and the flux
Side pressure is mixed using 0.5+0.5*(Up.normal)/|Up|; side velocity uses the sign of flux
SST divergence sources use conservative phi divergence, independently of the limited gradient trace
Implicit SST option follows omega then k then viscosity, bounded upwind advection, implicit diffusion/destruction, equation relaxation 0.7, and the newly solved omega in k destruction
rotatingWallVelocity projects the rigid-body velocity onto the patch tangent plane; experimental SST wall gradients now apply this projection
Native wall functions measure distance from the fluid-cell centre to the wall; previous road treatment used half the Cartesian cell width even in partial fluid cells
Cut-cell volume used 8-cubed samples and face aperture used 16-squared samples; a new optional piecewise-linear tetrahedral clipping computes volume and first moments without sample quantization
Road shear and SST wall distance can now use the clipped fluid centroid height; cell-centre pressure and diffusion geometry still use the Cartesian mesh
The SST Jacobi solver is checked against independently manufactured affine scalar solutions, including the updated omega in k destruction; this operator check executes no fluid steps

Pk(G) is evaluated after the omega solve in kOmegaSSTBase::correct: the new omega must update both k destruction and the production cap, not just destruction. Final-source correction updates both, with manufactured-solution coverage.

sourceControl.policy: Freeze all committed TypeScript sources from one git revision for the entire plan; stop on the first kernel initialization failure; validate kernels without flow steps before solving
